# Ship source and design provenance

<!-- markdownlint-disable MD024 MD033 -->

Generated from the same TOMLs as the game. Original designs are interpretations, not historical or authentic source geometry. MIT covers project-authored geometry; imported designs retain their listed terms and [original notices](../NOTICE.md). Dimensions may be estimates and are not SI docking-clearance measurements.

<a id="sh001"></a>

## SH001 - Adder

**Design:** Oolite 574ca848; CC-BY-NC-SA-3.0.

Source model units; envelope, not internal volume or SI dimensions.

**Appearances:** APPLE2, ARC, ARC-GOLD, BBC-COMPACT, BBC-DISC, BBC-MASTER, BBC-SP, C64, ED-LEGACY, ED-LIVE, ELITE-A, FE2, FFE, MSX-DISC, NES, OOLITE; **evidence:** D06, S07, S19, S32.

Imported numerical geometry and complete custody metadata are embedded in the TOML; original source files/notices remain separately attributable. Six zero-area source triangles across three assemblies are harmless and skipped by back-face projection.
